title: Cosmic Serpent Ritual
description: A dark surreal scene shows a large glowing planet with swirling colorful patterns suspended in a starry nebula. In the foreground, a horned shadowy figure with a wide grin holds a staff while standing on a rocky outcrop, surrounded by silhouetted robed figures and a massive purple serpent-like creature with multiple heads coiling around the planet.
prompt: A dark surreal cosmic ritual scene featuring a large glowing planet with swirling colorful atmospheric patterns in the center of a starry nebula. In the foreground on a rocky hill, a tall horned shadowy demonic figure with a wide toothy grin holds a golden staff, surrounded by several silhouetted robed worshippers. A massive multi-headed purple serpent with glowing rings coils around the planet, set against a dark cloudy space background with floating golden rings and orbs.
